title: Senior Recruiter (12-Month Contract)
description: <p>With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. </p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>OpenTable, a Booking Holdings, Inc. company, is seeking a 12 month fixed-term Talent Acquisition Partner to join our global team in London. In this role, you will be instrumental in recruiting fresh talent across multiple countries and departments, including Sales and Services, Engineering, Marketing, and Finance & Accounting. You will have a tangible impact on our business by acting as a brand ambassador, driving the full cycle recruitment process, and passionately advocating for candidate experience and diversity and inclusion.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Own full cycle recruitment responsibilities, continuously sourcing, screening, evaluating, and recommending candidates.</p> </li> <li> <p>Attract top talent and engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, networking, online databases, social media, employee referrals, and creative programs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Accurately track progress and maintain tracking metrics for recruiting using our ATS (Greenhouse).</p> </li> <li> <p>Act as a brand ambassador to build and maintain the OpenTable employment brand.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build positive relationships with employees across business functions and act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Pipeline talent for future roles.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>5 or more years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience prioritizing and leading multiple searches simultaneously.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable track record of acting as a trusted advisor to hiring managers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to work autonomously with a sense of urgency.</p> </li> <li> <p>Local to the London area and able to commute into the office 2 days a week.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience recruiting for roles across the EU</p> </li> <li> <p>Creative and results-oriented mindset focused on building positive relationships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Adaptability and flexibility in the workplace.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to communicate, interact, and negotiate effectively across time-zones with a variety of internal clients and external candidates.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Work Environment & Flexibility</strong></p> <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.</p> <p>If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Treasury Manager (ALM)
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Treasury is where Mollie's balance sheet takes shape, this team makes sure that our balance sheet is safe, well-funded and resilient. You, as Treasury Manager, will be one of the first people building the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) function for Mollie. This is a genuine 0-to-1 role. There is no legacy ALM framework to maintain, no existing ILAAP to update, no established models to inherit. You'll help design and build the liquidity risk framework, the interest rate and credit spread risk approach, and the funding and balance sheet strategy. Your work will feed directly into Mollie’s licence application and, once authorised, into how Mollie actually manages its liquidity and funding risks. You'll work closely with our product teams, Finance, and Risk Domains and your analysis will be seen by senior leadership and, eventually, by our regulator. As Mollie moves from application to operation, your scope will grow from building the framework to running it. What you'll ship Build and own the core building blocks of Mollie liquidity risk framework, including the ILAAP, LCR/NSFR monitoring, and liquidity stress testing. Develop Mollie’s approach to interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB), from risk identification through to models, limits and hedging strategy. Contribute to the design of Mollie’s funding and balance sheet strategy, including deposit mix, funding diversification and balance sheet construction. Build the Contingency Funding Plan and related early-warning indicators, so Mollie knows exactly what to do under stress before it needs to. Produce clear, well-documented policies, methodologies and models that will stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors, and Mollie's own second and third lines of defense. Support senior leadership (ALCO or its future equivalent) with the analysis, reporting and recommendations it needs to make sound balance sheet decisions. Partner with Risk, Finance and our external advisors, to make sure Treasury's frameworks are consistent with Mollie’s wider risk appetite and governance. What you'll bring Around 5+ years of experience in Treasury, ALM or balance sheet risk management, ideally within a bank, though experience in a fintech, PSP or consultancy building similar frameworks is also relevant. Solid working knowledge of liquidity risk (LCR/NSFR, ILAAP) and/or interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB). You don't need to be deep in both, but you understand how they connect to the balance sheet as a whole. Comfort building models and frameworks from a blank page. You're not looking for a well-worn playbook, you're excited to write the first one. Strong quantitative and Excel/financial modelling skills, with the discipline to document your logic clearly enough that someone else, including a regulator, can follow it. The ability to explain complex balance sheet risk topics clearly to non-specialists, and the confidence to defend your recommendations to senior stakeholders. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of this work that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgment and design. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building a bank's Treasury function from scratch, for Mollie and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like. AI at Mollie We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance and banking with us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

to provide updates on progress and address any issues or challenges encountered during store visits.</li> <li>Adhere to company policies and procedures at all times.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Field Service Technician Experience: Previous experience in a field technician role, preferably in field service, installation, construction, or a related field.</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues efficiently.</li> <li>Proficiency in using power tools and other installation equipment required for this type of role.</li> <li>Physical Stamina: Strong physical stamina to work on feet and perform physically demanding tasks for extended periods (up to 9 hours).</li> <li>Detail-Oriented: Excellent attention to detail to ensure maintenance work meets quality standards and adheres to specifications.</li> <li>Time Management: Ability to work well under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.</li> <li>Communication Skills: Effective communication skills to liaise with supervisors, team members, and We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.</p> <p>Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong><strong><br></strong>We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. You'll have the chance to develop across a varied portfolio of projects and build your career and experience.</p> <p>You'll join a collaborative team where you'll work with experienced client services and scientific colleagues. and Medical Affairs projects</strong></li> <li>Support publications including <strong>abstracts, posters, manuscripts and congress activities</strong></li> <li>Deliver Medical Affairs initiatives such working with the wider team to find practical solutions</li> <li>Develop your understanding of client strategy and the wider objectives behind each programme</li> </ul> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who has:</p> <ul> <li>Previous experience within a <strong>medical communications agency or similar healthcare communications environment</strong></li> <li>Experience managing multiple projects and competing priorities</li> <li>Organisational and project management skills</li> <li>Confidence communicating with clients and team members</li> <li>An understanding of the medical communications project lifecycle</li> <li>Experience in <strong>publications and/or Medical Affairs</strong>, with an interest in developing across both</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused approach</li> </ul> <h2>Why join Inizio Medical?</h2> <p>You'll gain exposure to different project types, clients and ways of working, helping you build a rounded title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one. This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. What you'll do: Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers. Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout. Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times. Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer. Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter. Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team. Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event. Our expectations: 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production. 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly. A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one. Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar). Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability. Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality. Nice to have Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud. Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path. Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP). Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes. What we value A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output. Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them. A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments. Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together. An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker. title: Data Engineer
description: Data Engineer London (Waterloo) · Full-time · Hybrid, three days per week in the office Who we are At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone. We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective. We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property. We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents. We’re looking for someone to own that foundation. The opportunity You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have. The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use. You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform. There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need. What you’ll do Own data as a product. Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable. Be opinionated about sources and quality. Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled. Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Ingest updates from sources such as HMRC and other relevant authorities, detecting changes promptly and turning them into usable, traceable data. Make data usable by our intelligence layer. Structure and serve information so our products and AI agents can retrieve the right facts in context. Preserve source provenance, geographic scope and effective dates so consumers can distinguish current information from historical or superseded guidance. Design for international expansion. Build shared models and ingestion patterns that accommodate differences in property markets, tax systems and regulation. When we expand geographies, we want to go at speed, without rebuilding the platform. Own reliability throughout the lifecycle. Build monitoring, validation and recovery into ingestion, transformation, storage and serving. Know what is stale, missing or incorrect, understand the customer impact and address the root cause. Set the technical direction and deliver it. Make clear trade-offs between immediate product needs and long-term architecture. Ship useful improvements early, document decisions and help shape the standards and future team needed to support the platform. What you bring Experience owning substantial data systems. You’ve designed, built and operated production data platforms or major parts of them, and can explain the architectural decisions you made and their consequences. Strong engineering fundamentals . You bring strong SQL, data modelling and production programming skills, with practical experience in orchestration, testing, deployment and operating reliable pipelines. Judgment about the data itself. You can evaluate whether a source is fit for a particular use, reconcile inconsistent information and make uncertainty or gaps visible to downstream consumers. Experience with messy external sources. You’ve handled inconsistent formats, changing schemas, incomplete records, rate limits and integration failures. You’re comfortable working beyond clean, well-documented APIs. A product mindset. You care about the decisions your data supports. You can work with domain experts and product engineers to translate an ambiguous need into a useful data product. Architectural ownership. You can review an existing system, establish a direction and deliver improvements incrementally. You understand access controls, privacy and the responsibilities that come with combining customer and external data. Clear communication and initiative . You surface problems early, write down decisions and challenge assumptions constructively. You’re comfortable making progress without a fully specified ticket. Bonus Experience building data foundations for AI products, including retrieval, document processing or evaluating the quality of information supplied to agents. Experience modelling policy or regulatory information, including versioning and effective dates. Experience with property, financial services, geospatial data or international datasets. Familiarity with GCP, where we run our infrastructure, and experience working alongside backend engineering teams. Experience establishing data standards or helping build a data team. This role isn’t for you if You just want to keep the pipelines running. You’ll need to care about which data we use, whether it can be trusted and how it improves the decisions our products support. You want a fully specified architecture to implement. We need someone who can assess what exists, challenge assumptions and take ownership of the technical direction. You only want to work with clean, structured data . Important information arrives through documents, policy announcements and inconsistent external sources. Making it usable is part of the job. You want to stay removed from the product or domain. You’ll work closely with product engineers and property experts. Understanding what the data means and how it is used is essential. You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind. Why join Own a data platform central to GetGround’s next phase of product development. Turn deep property expertise into intelligence that helps real investors. Work on challenging problems across customer data, property information, AI and regulated services. Shape the architecture for international expansion and help build our future data organisation. Competitive salary and meaningful equity. Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo. Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year. What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally. title: Growth Lead
description: About Nous Nous is an AI agent that takes some of the load of life; making good decisions and acting for our users in areas where they’re not the experts or aren’t paying enough attention. We've started with optimising bills, where we're already saving households thousands, and are now expanding into new categories. Similar to how Amazon picked books as its first category and grew from there. We’re growing fast, and it's working. 20x YoY growth makes us one of the fastest scaling startups in the UK. And NPS of +70 (higher than Apple) shows that our users love it. We've just launched two more novel new products (on top of our existing bill optimisation). Insurance: we're the first to get the regulatory approval and build the tech to actually do the full insurance discovery and purchase journey as an agent for the user (not just give them a link to the best deal). Subscription management: lots of companies use Open Banking to draw pretty graphs – we're the first to use it to actively save people money starting by cancelling unwanted subscriptions for them. It would be easy to look at this and think we've got it all figured out. But we've only scratched the surface; our ambitions are SO much higher. We’re building a new category of product which is hard, so we’ve stacked the deck in our favour: an experienced founding team with multiple exits, and investors including the founders of Monzo, Wise, Booking.com , lastminute.com , Onfido, Funding Circle, Tide, Habito and more. Still - the problems we’re solving are hard . ‘Talk is cheap’ applies to agents too. To have REAL impact, agents need to break out of the sandbox and take action in the real world where there are consequences. This means solving all the hard, thorny, interesting, frustrating problems the real world has to offer. ABOUT THE ROLE Nous is one of the UK’s fastest-growing, AI-native consumer start-ups. We’re looking for a commercially minded Growth Lead to help us continue to scale. We're hiring now because a member of the team is going on maternity leave, but this isn't fixed-term cover. You'll start on influencer — our biggest acquisition channel — and we'll expect you to be leading a second growth area within your first year. When they return, the team will be bigger and so your remit will grow. Nous is scaling very fast, and what that second area is will depend on where the business needs you most by then. We don’t expect you to have spent years in influencer marketing. You might come from B2B sales, partnerships, or another growth role where you’ve built a strong understanding of relationship management and what makes audiences take action. What matters is that you can apply that knowledge quickly. Your goal will be performance, not brand or reach. You’ll be hands-on across the channel: finding creators, negotiating fees, writing briefs, reviewing content and managing campaigns. You’ll also help answer the bigger questions — who should we work with, what should we pay, what content converts, and how do we scale the channel profitably? We’ve built internal tools to manage everything from creator outreach to performance and payments, and we’re constantly improving them. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you do need to be toolsy – using AI to automate repetitive work, improve processes and build better ways of working. WHAT YOU’LL DO Run influencer campaigns end-to-end — finding creators, outreach, negotiation, briefing, approvals and performance review. Make commercial decisions — work out what creators are worth, negotiate fees and structure deals that make sense for us. Create content that converts — write strong briefs and give clear feedback on creator content. Own performance — understand how we’re tracking against volume and CAC targets and act when we’re falling behind. Grow the channel — test new creators, propositions, platforms and approaches, then scale what works. Make us more efficient — use AI, internal tools and better processes to reduce manual work as the channel grows. ABOUT YOU We’re open-minded about exactly where you’ve come from. You might come from B2B sales, affiliates, partnerships or another performance-focused growth role. You’ll likely thrive here if: You have relevant hands-on experience. You’ve been part of a successful partnerships-led growth team. If you have not worked with creators before you can pick up the specifics of influencer marketing quickly. You’re commercially minded and numerate. You’re comfortable negotiating and working with CAC, conversion rates, budgets and targets. You care about performance. You’re more interested in whether content drove customers than whether it got lots of views. You have good creative judgement. You know what makes social content engaging, credible and persuasive. You understand social media. You have a strong feel for creators, audiences and what makes content work on platforms like Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. You can move quickly without sacrificing quality. You’re comfortable juggling priorities and making decisions in a fast-moving environment. You’re resourceful and toolsy. You naturally look for better ways of doing things and use AI to automate work, analyse data and improve processes. You’re happy in a start-up. You’re comfortable taking ownership, figuring things out and adapting as the company grows. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

It would be easy to look at this and think we’ve got it all figured out. But we’ve only scratched the surface; our ambitions are SO much higher. We started with bills because ‘change begins at home’ - it’s a naturally low-interest, messy area of our lives which most of us don’t want to think about. How can we use that stream of information and combine it with all the other data we have, to reduce friction from their lives? title: Director of Biostatistics
description: 🍊Our mission Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients. Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe. We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027. 🍊 About the role As Lindus Therapeutics builds out its portfolio through in-licensing, the Director of Biostatistics owns statistical strategy across that portfolio and stays hands-on, personally leading the statistics on live programmes from protocol through clinical study report. The Opportunity The AI Sim R&D team builds leading-edge ML and physics-based models ("LQMs") to advance drug discovery. Within this team, AQCell is our virtual cell platform: it takes a cell representation (e.g. basal gene expression) and a perturbation descriptor (e.g. SMILES, dose, and time), predicts the resulting transcriptomic response, and maps that response through pathway activity to functional endpoints such as cell viability, IC50, and toxicity dose-response — helping drug discovery scientists understand the biological repercussions of a compound across the cell, not just whether it binds its target. As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline. You will work across large, heterogeneous transcriptomic and functional-endpoint datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, and DILImap), train and evaluate expression-perturbation and cell-viability prediction models over them, and help harden our evaluation pipeline and baselines so we can trust and improve model performance over time. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning and biology, and offers the opportunity to shape how virtual cell models are trained, validated, and scaled toward real drug discovery decisions. Key Responsibilities Model Development: Build, train, and maintain machine learning models for expression-perturbation prediction (e.g. transcriptomic response to a drug perturbation) and downstream functional-endpoint prediction (e.g. cell viability, IC50, toxicity dose-response). Large-Scale Dataset Management: Acquire, harmonize, and manage large-scale biological datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, DILImap) — including schema harmonization, normalization, and de-duplication across cell, drug, and assay identifiers — and manage model training pipelines over these pooled datasets. Evaluation & Baselines: Contribute to automating and hardening the end-to-end evaluation pipeline, including implementing robust statistical baselines (e.g. cell- and drug-conditioned mean baselines) to rigorously benchmark model performance. Research Translation: Translate ideas from the scientific literature (e.g. transformer-based perturbation models, knowledge graph and GNN-based embeddings) into working, well-tested code integrated into our modeling framework. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with computational biologists, software engineers, and product stakeholders to ensure models are grounded in sound biology and are usable in real drug discovery workflows. Communication: Clearly document methods, assumptions, and results, and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Essential Skills & Experience Academic Foundation: Bachelor's degree in a scientific or quantitative field (Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, or related); an advanced degree (MS or PhD) is preferred. Applied ML in Science: Demonstrated experience building and maintaining machine learning models in a scientific discipline in an industry setting, including taking models from prototype through validation and maintenance; experience in a life sciences setting is preferred. Large-Scale Data Management: Required experience managing large-scale datasets and managing the training of models over them, including data ingestion, cleaning, versioning, and pipeline maintenance at scale. Software Engineering: Strong Python programming skills and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and experiment tracking/data versioning tools (e.g. Weights & Biases). Scientific Rigor: Ability to design sound evaluation methodology (e.g. train/test splitting strategies, held-out generalization tests) and to critically interpret model performance against meaningful baselines. Highly Desired Skills & Experience Bioinformatics & Computational Biology: Experience with bioinformatics and computational biology data analysis tools, particularly transcriptomics harmonization and normalization tools (e.g. batch correction, pseudobulking, gene ID mapping/standardization). Domain Datasets: Familiarity with public perturbation or drug-sensitivity datasets such as LINCS L1000, GDSC, DepMap, or single-cell perturbation atlases. Knowledge Graphs & GNNs: Experience with knowledge graph embeddings or graph neural networks applied to drugs, targets, or cells. Cheminformatics: Familiarity with cheminformatics representations (SMILES, InChI keys, PubChem/Cellosaurus identifiers) used to harmonize drug and cell metadata across datasets. Collaborative Innovation: Experience working in interdisciplinary environments where AI intersects with the biological sciences. Why Join Us? Schemas, CRUDL, bulk operations, permissions, third-party integrations. You can tell when a small-sounding request is touching something structural. Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.</p> <p>📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in <strong>Helsinki</strong> or <strong>Berlin</strong>.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong data-path-to-node="2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Please note:</strong> This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p>As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.</li> <li>Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.</li> <li>Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.</li> <li>Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.</li> <li>Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.</li> <li>Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.</li> <li>Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>How We Work</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatism:</strong> We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility:</strong> We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></h2> <p>Our backend services primarily use <strong>Go and Kotlin</strong>, while our frontend applications use technologies such as <strong>TypeScript and React</strong>.</p> <p>We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Our Humble Expectations</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for engineers who have:</p> <ul> <li>An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.</li> <li>Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.</li> <li>Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.</li> <li>Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.</li> <li>Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.</li> <li>The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.</li> <li>Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.</li> </ul> <p>You do <strong>not</strong> need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.</p> <p>What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <p>Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:</p> <ul> <li>Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.</li> <li>Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.</li> <li>Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.</li> <li>Integrations with external business systems.</li> <li>Kafka or other streaming technologies.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h2> <p>You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.</p> <p>You can read more about our recruitment process here.<a href="https://careers.wolt.com/en/how-we-hire"> here</a>.<br><br><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. title: Commercial Manager, Supply Chain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain</h2> <p>We're looking for a Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain to join our team. This is a global role spanning the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem, with Deliveroo as the hiring entity. This is a hybrid role based in our London office.<br><br>In this role, you'll help shape what our global supply chain looks like as DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt increasingly act as one unified company — building a highly efficient commercial approach to how physical goods, logistics, and courier equipment move across our operations worldwide. Rather than three brands running separate playbooks, you'll help design the single commercial model that brings them together, turning fragmented regional practices into one coherent, scalable supply chain.<br><br><strong>Get to know our </strong><strong><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers%2Edeliveroo%2Eco%2Euk%2Fthe-finance-team%2F&urlhash=INye&mt=71t6LOLRDB7Y7Pfyn-lkyQFuYJZgxwhcu4Gq__kgb35cdh7EuTjUCZ0KTYw-5LQX4ykuZen4DDkitnzN3rg_rotdLxY&isSdui=true" target="_blank">Finance</a></span></strong><strong> team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.</strong></p> <p> </p> <h3>What You’ll Be Doing</h3> <p>You’ll be joining the Global Supply Chain team, responsible for getting physical goods—courier apparel, equipment, in-store technology, and consumables—to our riders, merchants, and partners across every market. Sitting underneath the Senior Commercial Manager, you will build and execute sourcing strategies, lead complex international negotiations, and manage supplier performance across the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem.</p> <p> </p> <p>Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <p> </p> <p>Sourcing Strategy & Execution</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans</strong> across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing events</strong>, utilizing spend analytics, market intelligence, and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling to secure optimal commercial outcomes.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build and execute robust negotiation positions</strong>, focusing on unit cost, freight, duty, quality protections, and working capital impact.</p> <p> </p> </li> </ul> <p>Contract & Supplier Management</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Own the end-to-end contracting process</strong> in partnership with Legal, maintaining a complete contract register and enforcing lifecycle obligations, renewals, and rebates.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Drive day-to-day commercial supplier management</strong>, conducting structured performance reviews, establishing operational KPIs, and managing Joint Improvement Plans.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Mitigate supply chain risk and ensure continuity of supply</strong>, establishing dual-sourcing strategies, financial risk assessments, and strict ethical sourcing/modern slavery compliance across manufacturing partners.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner with operational and logistics leadership</strong> to align requirements, streamline specifications, and build credibility across historically independent regional teams.</p> <p> </p> </li> </ul> <h3>What You’ll Need to Thrive</h3> <p>Essential</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Significant experience in supply chain sourcing</strong>, with a proven track record delivering measurable commercial value across logistics, 3PL, or manufactured goods categories.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Demonstrated ability in end-to-end competitive sourcing</strong>, including hands-on contract negotiation with major international suppliers and manufacturing partners.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Proven capability in supplier relationship and performance management</strong>, with experience handling complex commercial disputes and driving joint innovation.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strong analytical and financial acumen</strong>, with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Exceptional stakeholder influence</strong>, with the ability to bridge operational needs with commercial outcomes across multi-region or cross-brand environments.</p> <p> </p> </li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have</p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience sourcing apparel or hardgoods manufacturing, including factory selection, quality control, and ethical audit frameworks.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p>Experience leading post-acquisition supplier consolidation or specification harmonisation.</p> <p> </p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with direct/inventory-based supply chains, including international freight, customs/duty, and working capital dynamics.</p> <p> </p> </li> </ul> <h3>Why Join Us?</h3> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <p> </p> <p>🔧 <strong>Make a visible impact every day</strong></p> <p>Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.</p> <p> </p> <p>🌱 <strong>Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment</strong></p> <p>Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.</p> <p> </p> <p>🧠 <strong>Build a career, not just a role</strong></p> <p>Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.</p> <p> </p> <p>🌎 <strong>Deliver together in an inclusive culture</strong></p> <p>Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.</p> <p> </p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire <a class="ng-star-inserted" href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/how-we-hire/" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h3>Our Global Structure</h3> <p>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p> <p> </p> <h3>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</h3> <p>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Insurance practice are looking for experienced Consultants & Senior Consultants to join the team.</span> </span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">Our Insurance practice works with the leading Insurers and Distributors across strategic advisory projects right through to business and technical change delivery. title: Senior Branch Merchandiser
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p></div><p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Branch Merchandiser will play a critical role in setting the branch merchandising strategy across retail stores and international locations.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>This is a newly created role that offers the opportunity to set the branch merchandising strategy and ownership structures across retail stores in the UK with scope to expand across additional international locations. The successful candidate will evolve and streamline the existing critical path — currently spread across multiple teams — into a cohesive approach to range planning, space planning, and allocation strategy, establishing clear processes across commercial functions. The Senior Branch Merchandiser delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p>Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Team & Leadership Impact</strong> (Build Championship Teams)</p> <ul> <li>Build strong working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally with Retail, Buying & Merchandising, Logistics, and Finance teams to ensure alignment and delivery against commercial objectives.</li> <li>Partner with supply chain and logistics to forecast short-term retail dispatch and DC volumes, and to determine the best delivery day, method, and frequency for each store.</li> <li>Gain buy-in at Senior Management level through excellent communication and influencing skills, presenting data-backed strategies and recommendations with confidence and clarity.</li> <li>Define the ownership structure and clear processes across the commercial functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fan & Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Deliver an optimised, balanced range for retail that meets and exceeds sales and margin targets, ensuring fans in every store have access to the right product at the right time.</li> <li>Conduct regular store visits to gather market intelligence and competitor analysis, translating insights into actionable range and space recommendations that elevate the in-store fan experience</li> <li>Partner with Heads of Retail and General Managers to identify existing and new commercial opportunities that drive availability and satisfaction across all store grades.</li> <li>Feedback market intelligence and analysis to Buying & Merchandising teams to inform future ranging decisions and strengthen the end-to-end fan offer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Trial and propose new ideas to move the business forward, including evolving allocation and replenishment systems for greater efficiency and accuracy.</li> <li>Manage specific projects end-to-end — documenting and analysing information, formulating conclusions, and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Potentialise sales and profit opportunities by store grade, using commercial analysis and data to unlock performance improvements across the estate.</li> <li>Develop and implement best practice distribution methods in partnership with merchandising and supply chain teams, optimising delivery frequency and stock flow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ownership & Execution</strong> (Determined & Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Set commercial initial allocations by category aligned with planned store turnover, space, and cover, and implement and manage the seasonal allocation and replenishment strategy by department and category.</li> <li>Analyse and review weekly, monthly, and seasonal trade by store and grade versus budget and prior year, proposing short, medium, and longer-term corrective actions with pace and precision.</li> <li>Manage store openings, modernisations, closures, and space changes in close collaboration with Buying & Merchandising teams to deliver successful launches on time and on brief.</li> <li>Oversee the smooth flow of stock across stores, maximising potential through initial allocation, re-assortments, and end-of-season stock removal to Outlet.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a fast-paced Retail Merchandising or Space Planning role, ideally within a multi-site High Street or omnichannel retail environment.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of store grading, range optimisation, space planning, and allocation and replenishment strategy.</li> <li>Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex trading data and translate it into clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively at all levels, including gaining buy-in from Senior Management on strategic decisions.</li> <li>Experience managing store openings, closures, or estate changes in collaboration with buying, merchandising, and logistics functions.</li> <li>A collaborative, cross-functional working style with the ability to build effective relationships across retail, B&M, logistics, and finance teams.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and a solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure and deliver to deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Manchester, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence <strong>3 days per week.</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.</em></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT THE TEAM</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, <a href="http://www.fanatics.com">www.fanatics.com</a>.</em><br><br><em>Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).</em><br><br><em>At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:</em><br><em>· Build Championship Teams</em><br><em>· Obsessed with Fans</em><br><em>· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit</em><br><em>· Determined and Relentless Mindset</em></p> <p><em>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description: <p>Senior Contracts Manager</p> <p>Location – UK - Windsor/ Edinburgh / Ireland - Dublin  </p> <p>Type of Work - Office</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Role Overview</u></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Contracts Manager to join the UKI Legal team. The role will support business growth and financial objectives by managing legal and commercial risk and enabling effective delivery of software and services to the NHS, and other UK & Ireland (UKI) healthcare and non-healthcare customers.</p> <p>The Senior Contracts Manager will play a key role in managing contracts across their full lifecycle, working closely with the Legal, Sales, Delivery and Leadership teams to ensure contractual arrangements align with business objectives, governance requirements and public sector procurement norms.</p> <p>As the senior contracts role in the UKI Legal team, the Senior Contracts Manager will generally be assigned the most complex, high-value and strategically significant matters. They must also operate with substantial autonomy within an agreed mandate, and help set standards, draft regional and global processes, and develop capability across the contracts function.</p> <p>This role will be based in either InterSystems’ Windsor, Edinburgh, or Dublin offices and may require occasional domestic and international travel. Office location will be determined based on the successful candidate’s location. An office location that is not Windsor will require periodic attendance at the Windsor office.</p> <p><strong><u>Key Responsibilities </u></strong><strong>– The role encompasses end-to-end contract lifecycle management, including pre-contract support, post-contract management, and risk and governance oversight.</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Pre-Contract Activities</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead legal team input into assigned tender and bid responses, particularly for NHS and other public sector procurements.</li> <li>Draft, review and negotiate a range of customer and supplier contracts, ensuring alignment with business objectives, legal and commercial risk appetite, and applicable NHS and public sector requirements.</li> <li>Provide pragmatic and commercially focused contractual advice to support sales and project mobilisation activities.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Post-Contract Management</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Take named, end-to-end ownership of a defined portfolio of client contracts, including high-value and complex contracts, holding accountability for commercial outcomes across the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Manage contracts following signature, including business adherence to contractual obligations, change control processes and contract variations.</li> <li>Support the delivery and operations teams in the practical application and management of contractual obligations throughout the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Monitor contractual performance, compliance and key post-signature obligations.</li> <li>Support the management of third-party vendors/sub-contractors and suppliers, both local and global, as required.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Risk and Governance</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the implementation, day-to-day governance, administration and continuous improvement of regional and global AI-enabled legal support technologies, ensuring effective, compliant and business-aligned usage across the legal function.</li> <li>Identify, assess and escalate legal and commercial risks to appropriate internal stakeholders and, where necessary, internal or external legal counsel.</li> <li>Implement and ensure adherence to internal contract management and governance processes.</li> <li>Manage ambiguity and develop practical, proportionate solutions to contractual and risk management challenges.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Stakeholder Engagement</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide clear, practical guidance on contractual matters to colleagues at all levels, including the Legal, Sales, Delivery and Leadership teams.</li> <li>Mentor and develop contract managers and other colleagues, setting standards and sharing best contract management practice across the global legal team.</li> <li>Coordinate with local and international colleagues to resolve contractual issues efficiently.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Experience/Qualification Required </u></strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 7-9 years proven, hands-on experience in high-value contract management, ideally within healthcare, IT, and/or the public sector. As a guide to applicants, evidence of a directly accountable portfolio TCV over £100M is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of operating with autonomy on high-value, complex and strategically significant contracts, and of leading negotiations through to conclusion.</li> <li>Strong drafting, negotiation and analytical skills, with a pragmatic and commercially focused approach.</li> <li>Comfortable working with digital workflow tools, document automation systems, and AI enabled legal support technologies to improve contract review speed, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of legal operations processes, contract lifecycle management platforms and AI-enabled legal technologies is highly desirable.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of using UKI model form contracts and frameworks, with an understanding of government and NHS procurement laws and public sector contracting norms.</li> <li>Ability to identify, define and articulate key commercial principles to support sound legal and business outcomes.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain complex contractual issues to non-specialists.</li> <li>Sound judgment, strong organisational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Degree and/or postgraduate qualifications with a legal or commercial focus are preferred; relevant professional qualifications are welcomed.</li> <li>Experience with AI-related regulatory environments such as the EU AI Act is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About InterSystems</strong></p> <p style="font-weight: 400;">InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit <a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https://www.intersystems.com/&esheet=53379223&newsitemid=20230410005415&lan=en-US&anchor=InterSystems.com&index=4&md5=3edf749fa33f5a2ac0c355c410576e90" data-outlook-id="1e721f69-f681-4067-9281-970e94b3ef11"><strong>InterSystems.com</strong></a>.</p> <p style="font-weight: 400;"> </p> <p style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>AI Disclaimer</strong></p> <p>InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information).  InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the <a href="https://www.intersystems.com/ai-use-guidelines/">InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines</a>. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.</p> <p>Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience.  AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.</p> <p>Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><em>strictly prohibited</em><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>during the interview and screening process with InterSystems.  Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><em>prior</em> to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p>CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. Good work shouldn't depend on you being available. Learn how we stay visible in AI-generated answers as well as search results. title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. ü Make our security controls provable Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements. Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort. Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved. Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. ü Strengthen access and identity controls Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. ü Extend our platform standards beyond AWS Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. ü Team collaboration Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. ü Self development Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar. Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption. Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation. Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. engineering and the types of challenges engineers at Monzo solve on a day-to-day basis.</p> <p>You’ll spend your internship:</p> <ul> <li>Writing, testing and shipping code that supports new features for our customers</li> <li>Reviewing code for your colleagues, to pick up any improvements and learn from your peers</li> <li>Working with product managers, designers and data analysts on your team</li> <li>Learning about new technologies, engineering practices and what a full-time software engineering role looks like</li> <li>Proactively seeking out feedback to improve and accelerate your learning</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be using: </strong></p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:</p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to
